info.title: AirREST Backend API Contract
info.description:
# AirREST Cloud Backend API Specification & Contract

This document defines the formal API Contract for the AirREST backend synchronization and collaboration service.
The default backend uses bearer JWT authentication. A custom client provider may use a separate cookie-backed
proxy or replacement authenticator, but cookie authentication is not provided by the default backend contract.
Any backend implementation (written in Go, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Java, Rust, C#, PHP, etc.) that complies
with this specification will work as an immediate drop-in replacement for:
- **AirREST Chrome Extension** (DevTools / Popup REST client)
- **AirREST Hub** (Web-based workspace and team collaboration dashboard)

---

## Key Architectural Principles

### 1. Standard Response Envelope
All HTTP endpoints return responses wrapped in a consistent Envelope structure:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```
On errors:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Human-readable error description",
  "code": "ERROR_CODE_STRING"
}
```

### 2. Authentication & Silent Rolling Refresh
- Authenticated endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
- Access tokens are JWTs (HS256) valid for 72 hours.
- Refresh tokens are rolling 30-day tokens.
- When the client receives HTTP `401 Unauthorized`, it transparently calls `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`
  with `{ "refresh_token": "..." }` and retries the original request upon renewal.

### 3. Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC)
- Mutable entities (`collections`, `collection_items`, `environments`) include a numeric `version` (int64).
- When updating, clients send `base_version`.
- If `base_version != current_server_version`, the server aborts the write and returns HTTP `409 Conflict`:
  ```json
  {
    "success": false,
    "error": "conflict: item has been modified by another user",
    "code": "CONFLICT",
    "data": { ...latest_server_object... }
  }
  ```

### 4. Soft-Deletes & Tombstone Deltas
- Deletions are soft-deletes setting `deleted_at = NOW()`.
- `GET /api/v1/sync/pull?since=<timestamp>` returns active items AND deleted items (`deleted_at != null`)
  so that distributed clients purge deleted entities locally and never re-upload them as zombies.

### 5. Hierarchical RBAC & Project Isolation
- **System Roles**: `superadmin`, `user`
- **Team Roles**: `admin`, `member`
- **Project Roles**: `admin`, `maintainer`, `contributor`, `reader`
- **Project Isolation**: Non-superadmin users can only view or query projects to which they are explicitly assigned.
- **Granular Permissions**: Collections and Environments support `min_role` (`admin`, `maintainer`, `contributor`, `reader`).
  Users with a project role below `min_role` are prohibited from reading or writing that resource.

### 6. CORS Configuration
Cloud requests from the packaged Chrome Extension are issued by an extension page with declared host permissions; the script sandbox only executes local scripts and does not call this API. AirREST Hub remains a Web SPA and is subject to browser CORS.
The bundled backend config accepts the following web origins by default:
- Allowed Origins: `http://localhost:*`, `http://127.0.0.1:*`, and `https://*` (overridable via `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`)
- Allowed Methods: `GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS`
- Allowed Headers: `Accept, Authorization, Content-Type, Content-Encoding, X-CSRF-Token`
- Exposed Headers: `Link`
- Allow Credentials: `false` by default (automatically enabled when `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` is configured with explicit origins, or controlled via `CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS`)
Deployments that expose the API to other web origins must configure and test those origins deliberately. Do not add the sandbox's opaque `null` origin: it is not a cloud transport context.

### Session revocation and resource limits
 Both access and refresh JWTs carry a nonnegative integer token_version matching users.token_version. Missing or stale versions are rejected with 401. Password changes and administrator resets atomically increment the version and revoke existing sessions. A self-service password change returns a replacement token pair for the current device; administrator resets revoke every target-device session. Profile changes do not revoke sessions. Refresh tokens can be reused until expiry or account-wide revocation; they are not single-use. Clients clear tokens and sign in again after a rejected refresh.
 Requests are limited to 4 MiB (including chunked bodies), 16 concurrent handlers per instance, and 300 seconds (5 minutes). Oversized bodies return 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Collection sync push/import also accept a single `Content-Encoding: gzip` member: compressed bytes are limited to 3,000,000 and decoded JSON to 16 MiB; requests must contain exactly one JSON document. Collection list/detail and sync pull responses use identity up to 4 MiB or gzip up to 3,000,000 bytes, with a 16 MiB decoded serialization cap. If no accepted representation fits, the server returns 413 RESPONSE_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; if identity and gzip are both excluded, it returns 406 NOT_ACCEPTABLE. Saturation returns 503 SERVER_BUSY with Retry-After: 1; timeouts return 503 REQUEST_TIMEOUT. Proxy limits may be smaller. Serverless initialization attempts are serialized with a 20-second deadline (120 seconds when boot migrations are enabled) and retries after 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, then 30 seconds; requests during attempts/backoff receive 503 and Retry-After: 1, retaining the nested SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE envelope with an additive `reason` (INITIALIZING, CONFIG_INVALID, DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE, MIGRATION_FAILED, BOOTSTRAP_FAILED, INITIALIZATION_FAILED).
Contributors cannot delete collections/environments or move collections. Request/folder deletion is collection:write authoring. Moves require collection:move and min_role access in both project scopes; private scopes require ownership (superadmins bypass role/ownership restrictions).

get.description: Returns health status for server monitoring.

post.description:
Registers a new user account. In default enterprise/secure mode, public registration may return
HTTP 403 Forbidden with `code: "REGISTRATION_DISABLED"` when provisioning is restricted to Superadmins.

400.description: Validation error or invalid request payload.

403.description: Public registration disabled.

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns signed access token and 30-day rolling refresh token.

Validates an HS256 JWT with token_type=refresh, issuer airrest-api, expiration, and token_version matching the user. Returns a renewed token pair. Old, missing-version, revoked, or invalid refresh tokens return 401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN. Renewal does not invalidate the previous refresh token.

get.description: Returns the user profile associated with the Bearer JWT token.

put.description: Updates display name and optional avatar URL for current authenticated user.

400.description: Validation error.

put.description: Verifies the current password and atomically updates the password and session version. It returns a replacement access/refresh pair for this device while invalidating every previously issued token. A concurrent credential change rejects the stale password update with 400 INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD.

200.description: Password updated successfully and replacement tokens issued for the current device.

400.description: Incorrect current password or password too short.

get.description: Search registered users by email or name (minimum 2 characters). Used for team/project assignments.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: General search query (alias for email query)

get.description: Retrieves all private workspaces owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new private workspace for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes private workspace. The initial default workspace cannot be deleted.

get.description: Lists teams of which the user is a member (or all teams if caller is Superadmin).

post.description: Creates a new organization team. Restricted to Superadmin.

403.description: Superadmin privileges required.

put.description: Updates team name and description. Restricted to Superadmin.

delete.description: Permanently deletes team and related projects. Restricted to Superadmin.

post.description: Adds a user to the team or updates their role (`admin` or `member`). Requires Team Admin or Superadmin.

delete.description: Removes user from team and unassigns them from projects inside the team. Requires Team Admin or Superadmin.

get.description:
Lists projects in team that are visible to the authenticated user.
**Project Isolation rule**: Unassigned projects are completely hidden unless the caller is Superadmin or Team Admin.

post.description: Creates a new project in the team. Requires Team Admin or Superadmin.

get.description: Retrieves project details and the caller's effective `user_role`.

put.description: Requires Project Admin, Team Admin, or Superadmin.

delete.description: Deletes project and its collections. Requires Project Admin, Team Admin, or Superadmin.

post.description: Assigns a user to the project with an RBAC role (`admin`, `maintainer`, `contributor`, `reader`).

get.description:
Retrieves collections in a workspace or project. Automatically filters out collections
whose `min_role` exceeds the caller's role in the project. The JSON response may use
`Content-Encoding: gzip` when accepted by the client.

parameters.name: include_items
parameters.description: Whether to attach active collection items to each collection in the list. Defaults to false to prevent payload overflow on serverless platforms. Detailed items should be fetched 1-by-1 via GET /api/v1/collections/{id}.

Content-Encoding.description: gzip when accepted and the encoded representation fits the transfer limit.

post.description: Creates a new collection in a workspace or project.

get.summary: Get collection details with nested items
get.description: Retrieves collection and all non-deleted folder and request items in hierarchical order. The JSON response may use `Content-Encoding: gzip` when accepted by the client; `Vary: Accept-Encoding` and `Cache-Control: private, no-store` are returned.

Content-Encoding.description: gzip when accepted and the encoded representation fits the transfer limit.

put.description:
Updates collection name, description, or `min_role`. Modifying `min_role` in a project scope requires `maintainer` or `admin` role (`403 Forbidden` if a contributor attempts to change `min_role`). Enforces Optimistic Concurrency Control
via `base_version`. Returns HTTP 409 Conflict if `base_version` does not match current version.

400.description: Validation error or invalid request payload.

409.description: Optimistic concurrency conflict. Data contains latest server collection object.

delete.description: Requires collection:delete (maintainer/admin), scope access, and min_role, plus the global `collection.delete` feature policy. Workspace owners and superadmins retain access but do not bypass the feature policy. Contributors cannot delete collections. Atomically soft-deletes the collection and all child items.

403.description: Permission denied or `FEATURE_DISABLED` when the global collection delete control is off.

post.description: Requires collection:move and collection min_role access in both source and destination projects (maintainer/admin), plus the global `collection.move` feature policy. Personal/offline sources may move into a project, but a project collection cannot move into a personal workspace. Private workspaces require ownership; superadmins bypass role/ownership restrictions but not this scope-direction rule or the feature policy. Project-to-project moves remain within the same team.

400.description: Invalid move request (missing/conflicting target scope, same source and destination, or cross-team project move).

403.description: Permission denied or `FEATURE_DISABLED` when the global collection move control is off.

404.description: Source collection or destination workspace/project not found.

409.description: Concurrent modification or scope state conflict during collection move.

500.description: Internal server error while moving the collection.

post.summary: Duplicate collection into a workspace or project
post.description:
Atomically clones a collection and all active items with fresh UUIDs and idempotency keyed by `(actor_id, operation_id)`.
Requires `collection:write` and `min_role` access on source, plus `collection:write` on destination.
Supports personal -> personal, personal -> project, and project -> project (same or different team).
Project -> personal is forbidden (`403`). When `targetRole < source.min_role` on a project destination,
the duplicated collection's `min_role` is clamped to `targetRole` to prevent self-lockout.
Does not depend on `collection:move` or the `collection.move` feature policy. Returns a compact receipt.

400.description: Invalid payload, UUID, or final collection/item name exceeds 150 Unicode runes.

403.description: Write access or scope boundary (e.g. project -> personal) denied.

404.description: Source collection or target scope not found or deleted.

409.description: `operation_id` reused with a different payload/fingerprint, or concurrent scope change.

413.description: Exceeds 5000 items, 32 depth levels, or request byte limit.

post.summary: Upload offline collection as an idempotent duplicate into cloud workspace or project
post.description:
Creates a brand new cloud collection from an offline tree with `min_role = 'reader'` and idempotency keyed by `(actor_id, operation_id)`.
Accepts identity JSON up to 4 MiB or one `Content-Encoding: gzip` member up to 3,000,000 bytes and 16 MiB decoded.
Validates 150 Unicode rune names, 5000 items, 32 depth levels, and typed `FormDataItem` attachment metadata before writes.

201.description: Offline collection duplicated to cloud (or idempotently replayed).

400.description: Invalid payload, Unicode rune name > 150, or invalid form-data metadata types.

403.description: Write access denied in target workspace or project.

404.description: Target workspace or project not found.

413.description: Exceeds 5000 items, 32 depth levels, or transfer byte limits.

get.summary: Paginated saved examples metadata or full payloads for a collection
get.description: Cursor-paginated endpoint returning active request items' example_count, example_summaries, and optionally full examples (include_body=true) with collection_version snapshot consistency. Responses support Accept-Encoding: gzip negotiation (Vary: Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control: private, no-store, 3,000,000-byte gzip / 4 MiB identity / 16 MiB decoded caps).

200.description: Page of collection item saved examples retrieved.

400.description: Invalid collection id, cursor, or limit.

403.description: Forbidden for user's role or scope.

post.summary: Atomically replace collection hierarchy and items (OCC + idempotent receipt)
post.description: Accepts gzip or identity JSON (4 MiB identity / 3,000,000 byte gzip / 16 MiB decoded, single JSON document), validates `base_version`, replaces items in one ACID transaction with `(actor_id, operation_id)` receipt idempotency.

400.description: Validation error or malformed payload.

403.description: Write access denied for scope or min_role.

409.description: Optimistic concurrency conflict or operation_id reused with different payload.

put.description: Updates parent_id and sort_order for folders and requests within the collection. Responses support Accept-Encoding: gzip negotiation (Vary: Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control: private, no-store).

400.description: Invalid reorder payload, cycle detected, or item outside collection.

put.description: Alias route for /api/v1/collections/{id}/reorder. Responses support Accept-Encoding: gzip negotiation (Vary: Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control: private, no-store).

400.description: Invalid reorder payload, cycle detected, or item outside collection.

post.description:
Creates an item inside a collection. Mutating an item atomically increments the parent collection's version and updated_at timestamp.
Validates payload structure and hierarchy (rejects malformed arrays, invalid auth, cycle, or non-existent parent).

400.description: Validation error, malformed item payload, or invalid parent folder.

404.description: Target collection or parent folder not found or deleted.

patch.summary: Mutate a single saved example (add/rename/delete) with OCC and receipt idempotency
patch.description: Applies add, rename, or delete on examples using (actor_id, operation_id) receipt ledger and base_version + base_example_revision concurrency checks without overwriting sibling request fields. Responses support Accept-Encoding: gzip negotiation (Vary: Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control: private, no-store).

200.description: Saved example mutation committed (or idempotent receipt replayed).

400.description: Invalid payload, format, MIME, or folder item.

403.description: Write access denied.

404.description: Item, collection, or saved example not found.

409.description: Version conflict or example revision conflict; includes latest server item in `data`.

post.summary: Move a request or folder without changing IDs
post.description: Moves an item and folder descendants atomically within the same workspace or project. Requires collection:write and min_role access to both collections. Preserves content and IDs; increments item and source/target collection versions and timestamps. source_collection_id is the location precondition (409 on a changed location); no base_version field. An identical cross-collection retry at the same destination succeeds. Clients must finish pending saves before moving. Import-batch retains copy semantics and must not be used for moves.

400.description: Invalid UUID, missing collection ID, destination folder, cycle, exceeding max nesting depth (32), or different scope.

403.description: Write access or collection min_role requirement failed on either side.

404.description: Item or collection missing or deleted.

409.description: Item location or authorized collection scope/min_role changed; refresh before retrying.

post.summary: Duplicate a request or folder subtree with new IDs
post.description:
Atomically duplicates a request or folder subtree within the same workspace or project, targeting the collection root or a specific folder (`target_parent_id`).
Requires `collection:write` and `min_role` access on both source and target collections.
Appends `" copy"` only when `target_collection_id == source_collection_id`. Snapshot-first cloning safely handles duplicating a folder into itself or its descendants.
Enforces 150 Unicode rune final names, 5000 items, and combined depth `targetParentDepth + subtreeDepth <= 32`. Returns a compact receipt.

400.description: Invalid UUID, invalid target folder, cross-scope target, or name > 150 Unicode runes.

403.description: Write access or `min_role` denied on source or target collection.

404.description: Source item or source/target collection not found or deleted.

409.description: `operation_id` reused with a different payload/fingerprint, or concurrent scope change.

413.description: Combined depth > 32, > 5000 items, or body exceeds limit.

get.description: Returns item details. Responses support Accept-Encoding: gzip negotiation (Vary: Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control: private, no-store).

403.description: Access denied to parent collection.

404.description: Item or parent collection not found or deleted.

put.description:
Updates request or folder details. Validates `base_version` against current database version.
Mutating an item atomically increments the parent collection's version and updated_at timestamp.
Returns HTTP 409 Conflict with latest server object if stale.

400.description: Validation error, malformed item payload, self-parent, cycle, or invalid parent folder.

404.description: Item, collection, or parent folder not found or deleted.

delete.description:
Request/folder deletion is authoring and requires collection:write plus collection min_role access.
Contributors may delete items/folders in accessible collections; this does not grant container deletion.
Soft-deleting a folder (`type === 'folder'`) recursively soft-deletes all descendant items and subfolders within the collection in a single atomic transaction.
Atomically increments the parent collection's version and updated_at timestamp.

404.description: Item or parent collection not found or deleted.

get.description: Lists scoped environments in workspace or project, filtered by project role vs `min_role`.

put.description: Updates environment name, variables, and `min_role`. Modifying `min_role` in a project scope requires `maintainer` or `admin` role (`403 Forbidden` if a contributor attempts to change `min_role`). Supports `base_version` OCC.

delete.description: Requires env:delete (maintainer/admin), scope access, and min_role. Workspace owners and superadmins retain access. Contributors cannot delete environments.

get.description:
Fetches all additions, modifications, and tombstones (`deleted_at != null`) since a given timestamp.
Used on extension startup and manual sync to reconcile local storage with the cloud backend. The JSON response may use `Content-Encoding: gzip` when accepted by the client.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp. Defaults to epoch (1970-01-01T00:00:00Z) if omitted.

Content-Encoding.description: gzip when accepted and the encoded representation fits the transfer limit.

400.description: Exactly one valid scope is required.

403.description: Scope access, operation permission, or min_role denied.

500.description: Database/query failure; no successful partial delta is returned.

post.summary: Batch push offline mutations (Stateless Delta Sync)
post.description: Processes at most 500 total collection, item, and environment mutations. Exactly one workspace_id or project_id is required. The request may be sent as a single gzip member with `Content-Encoding: gzip`; compressed bytes are limited to 3,000,000 and decoded JSON to 16 MiB. The body must contain exactly one JSON document. Mutations are applied independently, not as an atomic batch. Successful IDs appear in applied_ids; update failures appear in conflicts, while failed create/delete mutations are omitted from applied_ids. Contributor collection/environment deletes are denied by the same services as REST. Batch limits are checked before writes. The response always fits below 4 MiB; when required, oversized conflicts omit optional `server_data` while preserving applied_ids and conflict identity.

400.description: Exactly one valid scope is required, or the request contains malformed gzip or anything other than one JSON document.

403.description: Scope access, operation permission, or min_role denied.

500.description: Database/query failure; no successful partial delta is returned.

post.summary: Claim and import offline LocalStorage collections
post.description: Atomically imports into exactly one workspace or project. Limits: 100 collections, 5000 total nested items, 32 item levels, 4 MiB identity body, or one gzip member of at most 3,000,000 bytes that decodes to at most 16 MiB. The body must contain exactly one JSON document. Existing same-scope collections must be active and satisfy min_role. Scope, membership and collection locks keep authorization stable through commit. Unauthorized imports return 403 with no partial writes. Cross-scope IDs are remapped to fresh UUIDs. Authorized imports update metadata/items and increment existing versions without base_version OCC. Concurrent new-ID collisions return 409; retry the complete import. Deleted collections cannot be imported into. Existing item IDs in an authorized collection can be restored. The frontend rejects oversized selections; split manually into separate atomic requests.

400.description: Exactly one valid scope is required, or the request contains malformed gzip or anything other than one JSON document.

403.description: Scope access, operation permission, or min_role denied.

409.description: Concurrent import collision; retry complete import.

500.description: Database/query failure; no successful partial delta is returned.

get.description: Returns the global cloud capability flags for the authenticated client. The snapshot controls client UI only; move and delete are always rechecked by the backend.

503.description: Policy cannot be evaluated; cloud clients fail closed for controlled actions.

403.description: Superadmin access required.

put.description: Updates all three flags atomically. `base_revision` provides optimistic concurrency; unknown or missing flag keys are rejected.

400.description: Invalid revision or incomplete/invalid flags.

403.description: Superadmin access required.

409.description: Feature policy revision conflict. Data contains the latest policy when available.

get.description: Lists all users across the entire platform.

403.description: Superadmin access required.

post.description: Creates a user account with a specified system role (`superadmin` or `user`).

409.description: User with this email already exists.

put.description: Resets the target user's password and atomically increments their session version, revoking all their access and refresh tokens. Resetting your own password also signs out the current session.
Updates display name and optional avatar URL of a user.

400.description: Validation error or invalid user id.

403.description: Forbidden (Superadmin required).

delete.summary: Permanently delete a user account (Superadmin only)
delete.description: Permanently removes a user account, their private workspaces, and cascades memberships while safely reassigning created teams and projects to the executing superadmin.

400.description: Cannot delete own account or last superadmin.

403.description: Forbidden (Superadmin required).

BearerAuth.description: HS256 access JWT from login. Required claims: user_id (UUID), email, role, token_type=access, token_version (nonnegative int64), iss=airrest-api, exp; issued tokens also include iat. Database system role and token_version are authoritative. Both access and refresh JWTs carry a nonnegative integer token_version matching users.token_version. Missing or stale versions are rejected with 401. Password changes and administrator resets atomically increment the version and revoke existing tokens. A self-service password change returns a replacement pair for the current device; administrator resets revoke every target-device session. Profile changes do not revoke sessions. Refresh tokens can be reused until expiry or account-wide revocation; they are not single-use. Clients clear tokens and sign in again after a rejected refresh.

error.example: conflict: item has been modified by another user

data.description: The latest server version of the conflicting object.

permissions.description: Granular capability-based permissions computed from user role
Granular capability-based permissions computed from member role

value.description: Initial value shared and synced with cloud workspace

initial_value.description: Optional initial value alias for compatibility

SyncPushRequest.description: At most 500 mutations total across all three arrays.

message.example: version conflict: local base_version 1 does not match server version 2

BatchImportRequest.description: At most 5000 items in total and 32 item levels; all limit checks occur before writes.

target_parent_id.description: Folder in the destination collection; omitted or null selects the root.

PayloadTooLarge.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: body exceeds 4194304 bytes. Sync/import may also return BATCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED before writes.

ResponsePayloadTooLarge.description: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: no JSON response representation fits its transfer budget (4 MiB identity, 3,000,000-byte gzip, or 16 MiB decoded serialization).

NotAcceptable.description: NOT_ACCEPTABLE: both identity and gzip response encodings are excluded by Accept-Encoding.

ServiceUnavailable.description: SERVER_BUSY (Retry-After: 1), REQUEST_TIMEOUT, or serverless SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (Retry-After: 1). Initialization retries with bounded exponential backoff.

Retry-After.description: Present for saturation/initialization; retry after at least one second.

reason.description: Initialization stage that failed; during backoff, the last failure.

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid/expired access token, missing token_version, or SESSION_REVOKED. Clear the session if refresh is rejected.
